welcome.title: SAQR in one minute
welcome.body: SAQR hunts fake UAE police, bank and government websites, explains exactly why each one is a scam, and hands police the evidence to take it down.

early.title: Found before anyone reports it
early.body: SAQR watches new certificate logs and look-alike domains. Most of these scam sites were caught by SAQR itself, not reported by a victim, and the median shows how soon after registration.

uae.title: Built for the UAE
uae.body: This site pretends to be a UAE institution. SAQR knows the real domains and helplines of UAE police, government, banks and delivery services, so it can say exactly who is being impersonated.

explain.title: Every score explained
explain.body: No black box: each point of the risk score comes from a concrete finding, written in English and Arabic side by side, with the evidence underneath.

act.title: From finding to takedown
act.body: One click produces a police-ready evidence pack: screenshots, registrar, hosting, certificates and file hashes, ready for a takedown request.

accuracy.title: Proven accuracy
accuracy.body: These numbers come from a held-out test set of labelled links the model never trained on, including real official UAE sites that must never be flagged.

finish.title: That's SAQR
finish.body: Five things judges look for, each one shown on a real case.

phone.title: See it stop a real scam call
phone.body: A fake police officer calls, then texts a payment link. Play it on the simulated phone and watch SAQR step in.

phone_steps.1: Tap the phone screen once to arm it, then ring it.
phone_steps.2: Answer the fake police call, then open the link in the SMS.
phone_steps.3: SAQR blocks the link, and the case opens on this screen.
